data.name: Supreme Legend
data.detailed_description:
[Classic Legend, Reborn in Fire]
Experience the authentic Legendary RPG! Choose from Warrior, Mage, and Taoist—three classic classes—and return to the epic battlefield. Every strike counts with dazzling critical effects! Enjoy skyrocketed drop rates; even common monsters can drop Godly gear! All equipment is valuable and can be traded freely in the market.

[Massive Siege, Conquer Sacria City]
The ultimate cross-server Siege War is here! Gather your brothers, form the strongest guild, and fight for eternal glory on the battlefield! Lead your troops with real-time voice chat, engage in massive screen-filled battles, and relive the thrill of conquering Sacria City!

[Fast-Paced Combat, Unlimited Loot]
Say goodbye to boring grinding! Immerse yourself in intense, satisfying PVP combat with stunning skills and explosive visual effects. Engage in open-world PVP, slay world bosses for guaranteed divine loot, and carve your path from a rookie to the server's overlord! All equipment comes from battle—prove your might!

[Bountiful Rewards, Become a God Instantly]
New players get VIP privileges, legendary weapons, and bound diamonds immediately upon logging in! Claim daily login bonuses to boost your progress. Our 7-day login event rewards you with a top-tier Divine Pet, helping you slash through all dungeons and dominate the server with ease!
